title:
HE FLEW TO ISRAEL 🇮🇱
TO SAVE HIS HEART
note: Save a Child's Heart - ONE story, Julius (Zanzibar/Tanzania). Not a compilation. Hook = Tal on camera with Julius beside him: 'doctors were convinced they could not save his life' (question: how is he standing here?). Then Julius in his own words - sick, breathless, isolated, lonely - the Israeli team, his father's faith in Jerusalem, feeling better, back to school, his message to sick children. Coda: Miracle, the 9,000th child (the number beat), then Julius's last line 'everything is possible'. Sony footage is sideways with no rotation tag: Julius/Tal clips heads-left -> auto transpose=1; Miracle C0590 heads-right -> beat rotation 2 (checked on a still). All transcripts WhisperX-aligned 2026-09-29 (tools/align-cache.py). No music (Tal: not needed). Caption segments that straddled in-points (C0644 24.2/43.7, C0645 27.8, C0590 10.3) were split at those word boundaries in the aligned transcript cache (backup <id>.json.pre-split) - the builder drops a segment whose clock mostly lies before a beat. FRAMING: face-aim cropped the speaker OUT on the Sony two-shots (beat 3 aimed at Tal while Julius spoke; hook lost Julius; Miracle half out of frame) - the rotated Sony frame is already 9:16, so two-shots are pinned full-frame and Julius-alone beats get a manual 1.3x on him (x0.3,y0.45, measured off stills).

HOOK (C0634): Tal on camera, Julius beside him - 'This guy was born with a severe heart problem that doctors were convinced they could not save his life.' Two faces from frame 1; opens the question.
e268c5e3-f21f-4cad-ae40-af4b93aef14f
WHO (C0635): 'Hi, I'm Julius and this is my story.' His face, his voice, in the first 7s.

THE PROBLEM, his words (C0644 sit-down): 'When I was still growing up, until 10 years old, I felt some challenges, difficulty breathing, I could get tired, sweating at night.' Starts at 'when' (24.09): the first try at 29.40 landed inside 'old' - measured speech energy at 28.75-29.55, where the aligner claimed a gap.

THE HEART OF IT (C0644, one continuous take): 'I was facing such signs. I couldn't play with my friends, having fun' -> Tal: 'you couldn't?' -> 'doing sports... sometimes I could even be isolated' -> 'did you feel lonely?' -> 'yeah, I was so lonely.' Question and answer kept as one unit. (Started at 'I was' 43.54, in silence - 44.86 sat inside 'signs.' and snapped to a fragment.)
THE TURN (C0638): Tal - 'But then a medical team from Israel flew all the way to Tanzania on a mission to find children with serious heart conditions.'
JULIUS (C0639): 'I came from Tanzania all the way to Israel for the heart surgery.'

FAITH (C0645, one continuous take): 'So my father told me that... when, when, when... once we were in Jerusalem, told me I should believe I'm already healed before the surgery. So I did and we prayed, and I thank God it went well.' The hesitation is KEPT: cutting it split the sentence across a jump (verify-cut: ends mid-thought on 'that'), and it reads as him gathering himself before the line that matters.
AFTER (C0642, take 4 - the clean one): 'I finally started feeling better.'
WHAT IT GAVE BACK (C0641): 'I could finally go back to school and have fun and play sports.' Pays off 'I couldn't play with my friends'.

HIS MESSAGE (C0644): Tal - 'what is your message to any child that is having heart conditions right now?' -> 'the message from me to all children with heart disease and difficulties is that they should not give up.' The pause is his, kept.

THE NUMBER (C0590): Tal with Miracle, both smiling - 'and she is the 9,000th child that Save a Child's Heart has been able to save.' Julius was one of them; this is who comes after him. Heads-right source -> rotation 2.
PAYOFF / LAST WORD (C0644): 'The world should know everything is possible. And God - everything is possible, everything is possible.' Ends on Julius, not on Tal.
